info.title: Project Management API
info.description: Backend API services for Project Management System

post.description: Registers a new user, hashes the password, saves to the database, and returns a JWT access token.
Authenticates user with email and password, returning a JWT access token.
Logs out the currently authenticated user.

get.description: Returns profile information for the authenticated user.

put.description: Updates user profile, preferred username ('What should we call you?'), and resets password.

post.description: Generates a stateless 6-digit TOTP code (valid for 30 seconds), derived from the user's id + current password hash + a server secret via HMAC — never persisted to the database — and emails it to the user.
Verifies the code against the current +/- 30s TOTP window and issues a short-lived reset token.

post.summary: Set a new password using a verified reset token (Unauthenticated)
post.description: Validates the short-lived reset token issued by /auth/verify-reset-code and updates the password.

post.summary: Unified Create API (Path variable differentiator: 'project' or 'task')
post.description: Creates a new Project or Task depending on the '{entity_type}' path variable ('project' or 'task'). Enforces PBAC.

schema.title: Response Manage Create Entity Api Manage  Entity Type  Post

post.summary: Unified Update API (Path variable differentiator: 'project' or 'task' + entity_id)
post.description: Updates an existing Project or Task depending on '{entity_type}' path variable and '{entity_id}'. Enforces PBAC.

schema.title: Response Manage Update Entity Api Manage  Entity Type   Entity Id  Post

delete.summary: Unified Delete API (Path variable differentiator: 'project' or 'task' + entity_id)
delete.description: Deletes an existing Project or Task. Enforces PBAC.
